scene_013: Mosiah 11:20–26 identifies Abinadi as the speaker of this continuing prophecy. The scene omits him and incorrectly says the speaker is unidentified.
The quotation from Mosiah 11:23 is Abinadi’s speech, not narration.
scene_014: The speaker remains Abinadi from Mosiah 11:20 through 11:26. Introducing an “Unnamed messenger” creates an unsupported change of speaker after the preceding scene.
The claim that these verses do not identify the messenger as Abinadi disregards the supplied surrounding verses and chronology.
